vibe_rationale: Climber-led festival at a world-class crag on the UIAA calendar; strong single-scene core, but brand-organised by Tenaya.
fit_notes: Adult, outdoorsy and recovery-minded climbers, and November is quiet, so a recovery tent or post-climb hydration offer would stand out. Tenaya owns the event, so a non-competing service rather than a title role is the realistic route, and a local partner would be needed.
